children: Lawrence B. Seidman disclosed a 5.4% stake in URSB Bancorp, Inc.'s common stock. He filed the Schedule 13D on Sep. 23, 2026, after building the position across several affiliated entities. Seidman says he views the shares as undervalued and has already spoken with management about the company's direction.

Seidman describes the investment as opportunistic but open to further action, including more talks with management and potential proposals on capital, ownership, or operations. He notes recent engagement with leadership and board matters, saying he aims to maximize long-term shareholder value.

“Seidman had an in-person meeting and several phone conversations with the Issuer's senior management, including regarding the addition of Ray Vanaria to the Board,” and he “feels confident that the Issuer is working to maximize the value of the shares owned by all of its shareholders.” The group may buy more shares, sell shares, or hedge the position depending on future developments.

Lawrence B. Seidman is an American investor who manages Seidman & Associates LLC and related partnerships that focus on financial institutions. He is known for concentrated positions in community and regional banks and for engaging with boards to unlock value. Over several decades, Seidman has pursued a hands-on approach that includes dialogue with management and selective board involvement.
